messages:
Mira: rolling FP8 to the small H100/L40S cohort now — early telemetry looks odd, throughput down ~12% for some long-chat traces (>1k tokens) and p99 token latency spikes. cc @Santiago @Priya :thinking:
Santiago: on it. can you paste the kernel selection trace for a slow request? thinking the selector might be oscillating between quant kernels.
Mira: pasting trace excerpt and a tiny profile (sanitized):
```
kernel_selector: chose kernel_fp8_vA (seq<=512)
kernel_selector: fallback -> kernel_fp8_vB (seq>512)
dispatch: microbatch_size=4 -> apply_kernel_vA
dispatch: switch to vB at layer 18 -> sync + memcpy
elapsed: 0.93ms -> 1.38ms (+48%) at layer boundary
KV_cache: evict count increased by 3x during request
```
Santiago: aha — switching at layer boundary is expensive because vB has a different tiled layout and we pay a remap memcpy. where is remap happening (device->device or CPU bounce)?
Priya: from nvprof traces it's device->device but uses a slow path (cuMemcpyPeerAsync fallback) when block alignments don't match. that's the memcpy we saw.
Alex: repro script (run on a small H100 instance):
```
# minimal repro
./run_infer --model my-open --quant=fp8 --seq=1536 --microbatch=4 --te-flags="--kernel-prefer=throughput"
```
Alex: if you toggle `--kernel-prefer=latency` the selector picks vA for more layers and latency improves, but throughput drops for short-context workloads.
Mira: interesting. does transformer-engine flagging affect the tile layout? I thought kernel variants share same layout.
Santiago: they don't always. some FP8 kernels use pack-4 layout to vectorize, others pack-8, depends on tensor core micro-kernel. selector should avoid cross-layout switches inside a request. policy bug probably.
perf-bot: GPU counters (sampled 30s window): SM occupancy avg 56% (expected ~78%), shared_mem_bw high, memcpy_d2d_cnt +112%, tensor_core_util 64%.
Priya: occupancy drop lines up with layer where selector flips. vB has higher per-thread register pressure -> lower occupancy. combined with memcpy we lose perf.
Mira: ok actionable list?
Santiago: 1) add a rule: selector must prefer kernels with matching tile format to avoid in-request layout remap. 2) add a cheap static check based on model-width and seq to bias selection. 3) add telemetry label `kernel_layout` to traces.
Alex: propose quick mitigation: add a rollout switch in console to force `layout-sticky` policy for FP8 on H100 pools. That avoids oscillation while we fix selector logic.
Priya: also want to check KV cache eviction threshold tuning — looks like microbatch 4 + seq 1536 triggers slightly different KV chunking and increases eviction churn. maybe increase cache slab size for FP8 cohorts.
Mira: can we get an A/B run today? patch selector in canary with layout-sticky = true and enable for 5% of traffic to the cohort. I'll collect p50/p95/p99 + counters.
Santiago: I'll put a PR up for selector policy and add unit test for layout mismatch detection.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy queued for cohort-h100-fp8. Rollout: 5% -> 50% -> 100% with 15m observation windows.
Mira: thanks. if canary shows stable occupancy and no memcpy spikes, we can expand. also let's add a short-term engineered alert: if memcpy_d2d_cnt increases >50% baseline during rollout, auto-fallback to INT8/FP16 for that request class.
Alex: adding repro artifact to the perf board, and I'll capture a full trace (teprof + nvprof) for you all.
Priya: FYI, quality calibration: we saw no significant SROUGE/LLR drop with layout-sticky, but will run the eval suite.
Mira: perfect. action items summarized: Santiago PR for selector rule, Alex uploads traces and repro script, Priya runs KV slab tuning test + evals, Mira coordinates canary and watches telemetry. I'll circle back with numbers in ~2 hrs. :thumbsup:
